title: Foundation AD: deep health probes (replication + DNS + KDS + FSMO + gateway)
description: Runs `nexus health foundation-ad` (+ `--json`). Nine probes all green: per-DC reachability and AD replication (0 failures), the nexus.lab DNS zone, the KDS root key, the FSMO role placement, and the gateway's services + NAT.

observe.what: 9 probes green: dc-reachable x2, ad-replication x2 (result=0 failures=0), dns-zone (nexus.lab Primary AD-integrated), kds-root-key (3 root keys), fsmo-roles (FSMO=5), gateway-services (dnsmasq + nftables active), gateway-nat (masquerade)
JSON health: 9 checks, all status=green; ad-replication detail = 0 failures; fsmo-roles detail = 5 roles; gateway-nat detail = masquerade active

whatProves: FoundationAdAdapter.GetHealthAsync verifies both DCs are reachable and replicating (0 failures), the nexus.lab AD-integrated DNS zone is present, the KDS root key and all 5 FSMO roles exist, and the gateway's dnsmasq/nftables services and NAT masquerade are active - all green.
